content: {"phoneNote":"The header stacks phone number and directions link on two extra lines, pushing the headline 180px down, and the price list breaks the word 'Polnozr-nate'.","desktopNote":"Below the hero the page works well, but the menu and contact sections leave the right third of the screen empty and the footer repeats the address and hours shown just above.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Merge the contact section and footer: show address, hours and email once, and drop the phone number from the phone header since the fixed bar already carries it.","Collapse the phone header to a single row (logo + Meni) so the headline starts within the first 100px; let the price list wrap 'Polnozrnate žemlje' on a word boundary.","On desktop, let the price list and 'Pokličite' section span the full width or put the kneading photo beside the list to fill the empty right column."],"blockers":["Phone, price list: 'Polnozrnate' is hyphenated across two lines as 'Polnozr-nate'.","Phone and desktop: address, directions link and opening hours appear twice, in the contact section and again in the footer directly below."]}
